title: Terms Endorsed on the Annual Patronage Notice: Split, Minimum and Tax Reporting by Equity Class
content:
These are the terms on which the cooperative issues a patronage notice under Membership and Patronage Equity. They tell the member how the allocation on the notice is divided, how small an allocation must be before nothing is posted at all, whether the class is qualified for tax purposes, and how the notice reaches them.

| Class | Cash portion, per cent | Equity portion, per cent | Allocation below which nothing is posted, USD | Qualified for tax purposes | Allocation at or above which an information return is issued, USD | How the notice reaches the member |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | 100 | 0 | 25.00 | no | 600.00 | mailed notice |
| Class A Voting Membership | 30 | 70 | 25.00 | yes | 600.00 | mailed notice |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | 30 | 70 | 25.00 | yes | 600.00 | mailed notice |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | 0 | 100 | 0.00 | no | 600.00 | mailed notice |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | 30 | 70 | 25.00 | yes | 600.00 | mailed notice |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | 100 | 0 | 0.00 | no | 600.00 | mailed notice |

The two percentages in the first two columns always come to a hundred on every class. A class shown at 100 in the cash column retains nothing of what it is allocated; a class shown at 100 in the equity column pays no cash and retains the whole.

The reporting threshold of 600.00 stands on every class of Membership and Patronage Equity. Whether reaching it puts an allocation on an information return in the year it is declared turns on the fourth column: three classes are qualified for tax purposes and three are not.

**Worked on hypothetical figures.** On a class shown at 30 in the cash column and 70 in the equity column, an allocation of 1000.00 for the year is divided into a cash portion of 300.00 and an equity portion of 700.00. On a class shown at 100 in the equity column the same allocation is retained in full, the member receiving no cash on it.

**On the minimum.** Where the whole of a member's allocation for a fiscal year comes to less than the figure in the third column for their class, nothing is posted for that year. On the two classes carrying 0.00 in that column there is no such floor.
